steps.caption: Option 5C · Attention in the sidebar. Feed, Suggestions and Captures become rows with counts.
The counts are words in the place you already read. The strip keeps only Ask and capture.
A row opens its panel as the strip button did, and stays highlighted while it is open.
Fold the sidebar and a dot on its button says what waits: “2 need you · 4 captures”.
Labels for free, one less strip to learn.
